anomalies.title: Derivation embedded in the gold answer
anomalies.impact: The scored gold is '74.5-26.0\nAnswer: 48.5.', so a correct '48.5' scores as wrong.
anomalies.handling: Split at 'Answer:'; the derivation becomes the rationale, the gold is repaired.

What is the topic of the first section of the document?

anomalies.title: Stray trailing period on a short gold
anomalies.impact: Exact-match scoring fails on 'Mean' vs 'Mean.'; models learn to emit the period.
anomalies.handling: Canonical gold strips it; the original form stays an accepted variant.

anomalies.title: Markdown heading marks in title text
anomalies.impact: A derived title gold '# Suitability of Cubic Splines' asks for a '#' that is not on the page.
anomalies.handling: Leading '#' marks are stripped from derived title golds.

anomalies.title: Abstain token as the gold
anomalies.impact: '<no answer>' re-rendered as a sentence or JSON would teach the model to invent a value.
anomalies.handling: Abstain golds keep only the original form (no format variants).

anomalies.title: Pixel box outside the stored image (pre-resize frame)
anomalies.impact: Boxes point off-image or at the wrong place; 'top-right' and grounded targets are wrong.
anomalies.handling: Loader normalizes pixel boxes before resizing; rationales ignore pixel boxes until rebuild.

anomalies.title: Answer word recurs far from the title (tagline, spine)
anomalies.impact: The evidence box unions both places and covers the whole cover; position text is wrong.
anomalies.handling: Take each word's occurrence nearest the largest hit; drop matches more than 40% away.

anomalies.title: Title/author not found in the cover OCR
anomalies.impact: The answer cannot be grounded; any 'evidence' would be invented.
anomalies.handling: No rationale when fewer than 60% of the answer's key words are in the OCR.

anomalies.title: PubLayNet 'Title' also labels figure tags
anomalies.impact: 'How many titles?' gets a count no reader would give (figure labels counted as titles).
anomalies.handling: Title counts are not asked for PubLayNet; unambiguous classes only.

anomalies.title: Table with merged cells (row/col spans)
anomalies.impact: A naive (row, column) lookup reads the wrong cell under a spanning header.
anomalies.handling: Cell-lookup questions are only derived from span-free tables.

anomalies.title: Receipt amounts that do not add up
anomalies.impact: A subtotal/total rationale would assert arithmetic the receipt does not satisfy.
anomalies.handling: Arithmetic QAs are emitted only when the printed values satisfy the relation.

anomalies.title: Source rationale only restates the question
anomalies.impact: A 'Reasoning:' target that adds no evidence teaches the model to paraphrase, not to look.
anomalies.handling: Gate rejects it (fewer than 1 new content word); moved to reasoning_rejected.

anomalies.title: Rationale opens with the PAIRED question's verdict
anomalies.impact: 'Yes. Hong Kong was the largest…' under gold 'no' would train a self-contradicting chain.
anomalies.handling: The leading verdict is stripped and the remaining evidence is re-gated.

anomalies.title: Derivation text without values (a plan, not evidence)
anomalies.impact: 'Obtained from the table' / 'Find the year with the higher …' cites nothing on the page.
anomalies.handling: Dropped as a rationale; the gold is still repaired.

anomalies.title: Count derivation listed with '##' separators
anomalies.impact: 'Kefir ## Cheese ## Cream … → 6' looks like free text; split on ',' or 'and' it miscounts.
anomalies.handling: Items are split on '##' (else ';' / ','), never on 'and'; the count is then verified.

anomalies.title: Brevity suffix that conflicts with a new format clause
anomalies.impact: 'Offer a terse response. Respond with a full sentence.' is an impossible instruction.
anomalies.handling: The 18 measured the_cauldron suffixes (and near-variants) are stripped first.

anomalies.title: Non-English question
anomalies.impact: An English answer template ('The answer is 午前9時…') produces mixed-language targets.
anomalies.handling: Sentence-format variants require an English question.

anomalies.title: Unnumbered inline option list inside a sentence
anomalies.impact: Parsed as an 'Options:' list, the whole sentence tail becomes one fake option.
anomalies.handling: Only a line-initial 'Options:' list counts; inline lists get no option-number variant.

anomalies.title: Dot as thousands separator ('60.000')
anomalies.impact: Read as 60.0, receipt arithmetic and 'most expensive item' come out wrong.
anomalies.handling: parse_number reads 3-digit dot groups as thousands for receipts (not for TAT-QA).

anomalies.title: Accounting negative in a derivation ('(6,919)')
anomalies.impact: Evaluated as +6919, '7,572 - (6,919)' gives 653 instead of the gold 14,491.
anomalies.handling: safe_eval reads a parenthesized bare number as negative.

anomalies.title: Percent used as a fraction ('65% * 3,433')
anomalies.impact: Dropping '%' gives 223,145 instead of 2,231.45; the derivation looks wrong when it is right.
anomalies.handling: Both readings (percentage points, fraction) are tried; the one matching the gold is kept.

anomalies.title: Decimal with a leading zero and 3 decimals ('0.039')
anomalies.impact: A thousands-separator rule reads it as 39.
anomalies.handling: Thousands groups must start with a non-zero digit.
